transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you here today?

Well, what brought me in is... I keep hearing a man’s voice. It happens a lot at work. I'll hear him coming from the garage vents, or sometimes right from under the hood of a car I'm working on. And it’s not muffled or anything, it's as clear as somebody standing right next to me. 

He keeps telling me... well, he tells me not to trust my husband, and he says I shouldn't touch certain cars in the shop. It's just getting really hard to deal with, so I figured I needed to come in.
Have you ever seen things that others don't see, or experienced any other unusual sensations like feeling something that isn't there?

No, I haven't seen anything like that. It's really just the voice. I don't feel anything touching me or... anything weird like that either, if that's what you mean. It's just hearing him while I'm working.
Have you had any strange or unusual thoughts, like believing something that others don’t seem to believe, even though they might not make sense?

Well, yeah. I know it probably sounds far-fetched when I say it out loud, but... I'm convinced my husband and the shop owner are tracking what I'm doing. I think they've been using the EV chargers and the security cameras at work to monitor me. They've tried to tell me I'm wrong, and they even show me the camera footage and say there's nothing there, but... I don't know. I still believe they're doing it.
Do you have any other beliefs that others might find unusual or hard to understand, outside of what you've told me about your husband and the shop?

No, not really. I mean... besides what I just told you about the cameras and them tracking me, I don't have any other thoughts like that. It's pretty much just focused on my husband and my boss. I don't think anyone else is after me or anything.
Have you ever had any beliefs that you know are unusual or not based in reality, separate from what you've been experiencing at work with the voice and being monitored?

No, I don't think so. It's really just what I already mentioned... the voice and the feeling that my husband and boss are tracking me. I haven't had any other strange beliefs or thoughts besides that. It's all just tied to that situation.
Has there ever been a time when you felt like things were this way for a month or more without getting better, even after trying to cope or distract yourself?

Yeah, it's been way longer than a month, actually. Um... the voices and the whole thing with them tracking me, that's been happening for about ten months now. It just hasn't really stopped or gotten any better in all that time.
Have you ever had any other unusual beliefs or suspicions that you haven't already mentioned, even if they seemed strange to you at the time?
No, like I said, it's really just the stuff with my husband and my boss. I don't have any other suspicions or... weird beliefs about anything else. It's just what I've already told you.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt down or hopeless nearly every day, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy, for at least two weeks?

No, I haven't really felt like that. I mean, sure, the situation with work and my husband is really stressful, but I don't get depressed or hopeless. I haven't lost interest in things or felt down for weeks at a time. I just don't really get like that.
Have you ever had any other unusual or fixed beliefs—like thinking you have special powers, that someone is in love with you, or that something is wrong with your body in a way that others don’t see?

No, I don't have anything like that. I don't think I have any special powers or anything. And I know my body is fine, I work on cars all day, I have to be in decent shape. It's really just the tracking thing with my husband and my boss that I told you about. That's the only thing going on.

Have you ever had any other kinds of unusual or unshakable beliefs, even if they seemed unlikely, such as thinking you were being poisoned, that you had a serious illness others couldn't detect, or that someone was sending you secret messages?

No, nothing like that. Nobody is trying to poison me, and I'm not getting secret messages from anywhere or anything. I know you probably have to ask all these, but... yeah, it really is just the tracking situation I keep bringing up. None of that other stuff is happening to me.
Have you ever had any suspicions or beliefs about your husband being unfaithful or involved with someone else in a way that others might not believe?
No, I haven't. I mean, my husband and I have our issues with him tracking me and talking to my boss, but I don't think he's cheating on me or anything like that. That's not what this is about.

Are your concerns about being tracked and monitored the only things that have been troubling you, or have you had any other similar thoughts about being harmed, conspired against, or targeted in other ways?
No, it's really just the tracking. Nobody is trying to harm me or target me in any other way. It's just my husband and my boss keeping tabs on me like I said. That's the only thing.
Can you explain exactly what you believe your husband and your boss are doing to track you, and do you think they are working together on this?

I know it sounds far-fetched, but I’m still convinced my husband and the shop owner have been using the EV chargers and the security cameras at work to track what I’m doing. I think they're definitely working together. They even show me the security footage and say there’s nothing there, but... I know what they're doing. They're keeping tabs on me through the chargers and the cameras.
Are there any other people or situations outside of your husband and boss that you believe are involved in monitoring or conspiring against you in any way?

No, it's just them. I don't think anyone else is involved. It's just my husband and the shop owner doing this. I haven't noticed anyone else trying to monitor me or anything like that. Just the two of them.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being put into your mind by someone else, or that someone can read your thoughts or control them in any way?

No, I've never felt anything like that. My thoughts are my own. Nobody is putting things in my head or reading my mind or anything. It's just the tracking with the cameras and the chargers that I told you about.
Have you ever had any other delusional beliefs or experiences where you believed something strongly that turned out not to be true, even if you haven’t mentioned it yet?

No, I haven't. I mean, besides what I just told you about my husband and my boss, there's nothing else. I don't have any other beliefs like that, and I haven't experienced anything else that wasn't true. It's really just the tracking thing.
Have you had continuous signs that something was wrong or that you were experiencing disturbances like hearing voices or believing you were being tracked for at least 6 months?

Yeah, it's been going on for a while now. I'd say about a year and three months. It all started when the arguments at home with my husband got really bad... mostly over my late nights and how much time I was spending at the shop. That's when I first started noticing the tracking and the voices. So, yeah, definitely more than six months.
Have you had continuous signs that something was wrong or disturbances like hearing voices or believing you were being tracked for at least 12 months?

Yeah, like I just said, it's definitely been longer than 12 months. Um, it's been going on for about a year and three months now. That's when the arguments at home over my late nights and shop commitments got much worse, and all this started.
Have you ever believed anything else that others might find strange or untrue, even if it wasn’t related to being tracked by your husband or boss?
No, I really haven't. Like I said earlier, it's just the stuff with my husband and my boss. There's nothing else that I believe that other people think is strange. Just the tracking.
